title: Flex Cluster Description Update
description: Settings that you can specify when you update a flex cluster.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

tags.description: List that contains key-value pairs between 1 to 255 characters in length for tagging and categorizing the instance.

terminationProtectionEnabled.description: Flag that indicates whether termination protection is enabled on the cluster. If set to `true`, MongoDB Cloud won't delete the cluster. If set to `false`, MongoDB Cloud will delete the cluster.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

ResourceTag.description: Key-value pair that tags and categorizes a MongoDB Cloud organization, project, or cluster. For example, `environment : production`.

key.description: Constant that defines the set of the tag. For example, `environment` in the `environment : production` tag.

value.description: Variable that belongs to the set of the tag. For example, `production` in the `environment : production` tag.

ResourceTag.title: Resource Tag
